statements.t: “We have presented clinical data that demonstrated the potential of delivering alpha radiation via our proprietary targeted oncology platform,” said Thijs Spoor, Perspective’s Chief Executive Officer.

“With encouraging clinical findings observed to date that further support the best ‑ in ‑ class potential of bamzireotide, continued progress across two additional programs targeting melanoma and FAP-α-positive solid tumors, and investments in our manufacturing capabilities, we are well-positioned to lead the development of the field.”
We are targeting an end-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA in 1Q 2027.
Manufacturing: We expect construction to be completed at the Chicago metro site in early 2027.
The Company has proprietary technology that utilizes the alpha-generating isotope 212 Pb to deliver powerful radiation specifically to cancer cells via specialized targeting moieties.
The Company is also developing complementary imaging techniques that incorporate the same targeting moieties, creating an opportunity to personalize treatment and optimize patient outcomes.
